name: Alice: Time Rift

features.name: Sticky Respins
features.description: Scatters and wilds lock symbols in place.

features.name: Random bonus modifiers
features.description: The bonus starts with a random boost.

review:
Alice: Time Rift is a dark steampunk take on Wonderland on a 3x5 grid with 10 paylines. Scatters and wilds trigger sticky respins, locking symbols in place to build up wins and set up near-misses on the bonus.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 7,500x cap. The published RTP is 94.10%, so it returns less on average than many slots.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
